dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire I've walked this earth for 46 years. I've been in many relationships and experienced plenty of heartbreaks. I've refused women when I was in a relationship every time because I've felt the pain of betrayal and I NEVER want to be the reason someone feels it.

@dogecoin_empire Yes. I know nobody will believe it, but each time I was cheated on, I knew it because it literally feels like something was ripped off my heart. Even when I was 5,000 miles away in Iraq fighting for her while trying to stay alive, it yanked me from my sleep when it happened. 😔
